name: periscope
description: A web-based Kubernetes control plane for visualizing and managing cluster state, security, workloads, Helm releases, and Zarf packages.

scripts.build:bin:linux: npm run bundle && pkg . --targets node22-linux-x64 --output dist/periscope-linux-amd64 -C GZip --no-bytecode --public-packages "*" --public
scripts.build:bin:win: npm run bundle && pkg . --targets node22-win-x64 --output dist/periscope-windows-amd64.exe -C GZip --no-bytecode --public-packages "*" --public
scripts.build:bin: npm run build:bin:linux && npm run build:bin:win

author: jdmldm1
